rate_limits: Default maximum 10 requests/second per team (shared across all API keys); increasable for trusted senders on request. Daily/monthly email quotas apply separately.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Both wrong. Original (~2 rps) matches only the May 2023 changelog; auditor’s 5 rps is also incorrect. Current official docs: default is 10 requests/second per team. https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/rate-limit and https://resend.com/docs/knowledge-base/account-quotas-and-limits
